instructions: Only prompt and prepared context go to the runner. Labels and scoring notes stay with the evaluator. Observe actual skill loading; self-reported intent alone is insufficient. Cases require fixtures and fresh sessions; this file is not an executable suite.

scoring.initial_selection: Observe the first of these two skills loaded, or neither. Other host skills are outside this label set.
scoring.later_selection: For mixed cases, observe the required later skill at a real checkpoint in a separate end-to-end test. Initial-only routing does not verify later invocation.
scoring.companion_policy: For foundation-only cases, a later justified companion pass is not automatically an initial-routing error.
scoring.label_policy: Review labels before execution; do not relabel selectively after seeing candidate results.

cases.prompt: Create a Python CLI that reads a transaction CSV and aggregates totals by category. The repo is empty; build a working flow with basic tests.
cases.context_required: Empty repository; Python available; small CSV examples.

cases.prompt: Add JSON export to the existing CLI. Keep current commands and text output unchanged unless the new flag is present.
cases.context_required: Working CLI with command tests and a documented output contract.

cases.prompt: The search function is dropping valid 0 values. Fix that bug and add regression tests while preserving all remaining behavior.
cases.context_required: Repository with a reproducible zero-value bug and existing test framework.

cases.prompt: The API must now support multiple tenants. Implement the new contract and migrate existing persisted records without losing valid data.
cases.context_required: Existing API, explicit tenant requirements, persisted fixtures and consumers.

cases.prompt: Continue the transaction import feature from the previous session. Notes say it's not done, but code is partially implemented; verify requirements and complete the missing parts.
cases.context_required: Original acceptance requirements, stale notes and partially implemented import feature.

cases.prompt: Refactor the storage boundary to support the requested cloud backend, then implement that backend. The existing local mode must keep working.
cases.context_required: Documented new backend requirements, local storage implementation and contract tests.

cases.prompt: Add a status filter to the orders page. I have uncommitted changes in this component; keep them and continue following existing conventions.
cases.context_required: Frontend repository with identifiable user edits and a requested filter contract.

cases.prompt: Build the first working slice of this new import module inside our existing repository. Reuse the current build and test setup.
cases.context_required: Established repository, empty bounded module and sample input/output requirements.

cases.prompt: Review the current diff for me, reporting only defects backed by evidence and file locations. Do not modify any code.
cases.context_required: Small working-tree diff with an identifiable comparison base.

cases.prompt: Simplify this feature diff where there is a concrete maintenance benefit. Preserve the feature's intended behavior and avoid unrelated edits.
cases.context_required: Completed feature diff, task requirements and affected tests.

cases.prompt: Two validation blocks in the diff look duplicate. Check if they share business logic and ownership; consolidate only if there is a concrete benefit.
cases.context_required: Diff with two similar validation blocks and enough domain context to distinguish ownership.

cases.prompt: The implementation is done. Review its error handling, resource cleanup and public contracts before we hand it off. Report only.
cases.context_required: Completed implementation with callers, failure paths and test baseline.

cases.prompt: I want to rehabilitate this repository's quality in small batches while preserving consumed behavior. Survey and address evidenced issues.
cases.context_required: Bounded sample repository with documented behavior and permission for repository-wide rehabilitation.

cases.prompt: Apply the confirmed findings from the previous review to this diff. Check that they still hold and keep unrelated user changes intact.
cases.context_required: Earlier findings supplied as task data, current code and distinct user changes.

cases.prompt: Clean up the AI-generated code in this diff: remove evidenced residue, keep invariant comments, and do not change outputs used downstream.
cases.context_required: Diff with mixed comments, debug residue and consumed observable output.

cases.prompt: This diff intentionally changes the API to v2. Audit and tidy the implementation without undoing that approved contract change.
cases.context_required: Explicit v2 contract, migration diff and relevant callers/tests.

cases.prompt: Fix the exact typo 'instalation' to 'installation' in README. No review needed for the rest.
cases.context_required: README with one specified typo.

cases.prompt: Translate the pasted paragraph explaining refactoring into English. Do not inspect or modify the repository.
cases.context_required: A short pasted paragraph about refactoring, requiring translation only.

cases.prompt: Briefly explain the difference between git diff and git diff --staged, without running commands or editing files.
cases.context_required: No repository fixture needed; conceptual Git question.

cases.prompt: In the pasted review comment, replace the word 'utilize' with 'use'. Return only the edited sentence.
cases.context_required: One pasted sentence containing utilize; no code review requested.

cases.prompt: Add CSV export as requested, verify it, then review and clean up the diff once before marking complete.
cases.context_required: Existing export interface, CSV acceptance examples and affected tests.

cases.prompt: Implement the approved schema migration, then do a scoped review and cleanup of the completed change while preserving the new contract.
cases.context_required: Migration specification, old records, expected new schema and callers.

cases.prompt: Continue the unfinished feature from these notes, satisfy acceptance criteria, then inspect the diff to eliminate unintended churn and contract breaks.
cases.context_required: Stale session notes, acceptance requirements and partially implemented feature.

cases.prompt: Build a working first slice of the new module using repository conventions. Once it passes its checks, review the diff and remove only justified residue.
cases.context_required: Existing build/test conventions, empty module and bounded acceptance requirements.
